status: FAIL for autonomous Task12 and long-workflow qualification
fixture: Fresh frozen Task12 e12code64a, private ignored workspace and raw transcripts in /private/tmp/kryn-64k-pipeline/evals/runs/e12code64a. Existing OpenCode/oMLX, guarded private 64K owner profile. No product install or release from this trial.

observations.planning: Read-only Plan inspected the fixture and produced a useful acceptance checklist without implementation edits. Its first checkpoint accurately marked unobserved work unknown.
observations.backend: The first Build read server/store/parser before editing, but timed out. Its generated test deleted data/entries.csv and reused one database; the operator preserved the failed test in private evidence, restored the seed from fixture Git and removed the broken test. The frozen grader then passed 2/2 backend checks. An operator-started baseline server had initially occupied the agent's chosen port, making its first 404/501 test receipt an evaluator setup error, not proof the edited source lacked routes.
observations.handoff: After restart, Ask recalled routes but invented failure causes and an unverified database reset; the next native checkpoint put agent choices under Decisions and listed already implemented routes as active work. Semantic continuity failed despite completed native compactions.
observations.backend_edge: An independent isolated HTTP probe found GET /api/entries?project= returned all rows. One model repair still did so and reported it as correct. After two unsuccessful model attempts, the operator made the one-line filter correction. The same independent probe then passed 6/6 and frozen automatic checks passed 2/2; this is assisted artifact success, not autonomous agent success.
observations.browser_first: Independent 390px Chrome Save timed out waiting for POST; only initial GETs appeared. Candidate code used nonexistent JSON.fromObject and classified every new nonempty ID as an edit.
observations.browser_second: After one model UI repair, independent 390px Chrome Save again timed out waiting for POST; network observed PATCH /api/entries/<new-id> returning 400. Later browser flows were not reached. Candidate UI also interpolated user-controlled row data into innerHTML and parsed import's JSON count as plain text.
observations.review: Fresh read-only Reviewer found real innerHTML injection and import response mismatch, but falsely claimed JSONDecodeError bypasses ValueError and SQLite with-block batch inserts commit partial rows. It misidentified the edit failure. Reviewer accuracy failed; the frozen Task12 manual review gate is not a pass.
observations.resource: Seven native stages totaled 1071.253 prompt-active wall seconds (17.85 minutes), all on AC power. All 520 sampled resource rows showed normal host pressure level 1 and zero observed swap growth. No resource guard abort occurred. This is below the 45-60 minute green endurance requirement and says nothing about a reliably useful 96K/128K tier.

separate_safe_fix: Observed Agent shell used lsof | xargs kill -9 on disposable port 62138. PR #44 blocks the xargs signal form, passed make check and CI, and merged to public main cc86f5f. The installed private 64K candidate was not changed.
packaging: Public main cc86f5f passed make package-smoke in an isolated temporary environment. Non-owner macOS clean install/update/rollback remains untested without access to a separate standard account; prior owner rollback/reinstall evidence is unchanged.
next_blocker: Change implementation/evaluation approach rather than add a third UI prompt: use a fresh untouched fixture with executable feedback at each vertical slice, qualify truthful compaction/restart and reviewer output, and only then run the 45-60 minute green active endurance and non-owner install/rollback gates.
